title_en: APARTMENT 1+1 FOR SALE AT SHESI AQPONJA
description_en: The 1+1 apartment is located on the 3rd floor of an 8-story building in the area of ​​Laprak, in the former Sheshi Shqiponja. Tirana Face The strategic location in the New Ring, at the Shqiponja square roundabout, is the new center for housing, business and institutions, is another added value. The project is connected to the Great Ring of the capital and has direct access to all new rings and entrances/exits from Tirana, which makes its position one of the main advantages. • Net area: 65.64 m² • Gross area: 73.52 m² • Floor: 2nd living or 4th from the ground • 1 living room together with the kitchen area, 1 bedroom, 1 spacious balcony with access from both rooms and 1 bathroom • Regular layout • Possibility to purchase post parking at an extra price • Suitable for living or investing in a sought-after area Tirana • The building has just been completed and living has begun, while the apartment is in the refinishing phase. • For more information, please contact us!
